frozen_reference.conclusion: M2C ANALYTICS NOT YET FROZEN - EVIDENCE GAP REMAINS

frozen_protocol_unchanged.calibration: Platt on validation split only; test labels never used

research_targets_clearly_separate.rt_new_stress: newly stressed borrower, no network attribution - higher power confirmatory target
research_targets_clearly_separate.rh_stress_{1,2,4,8,12}w: observed stress within horizon h, for the horizon sweep only
research_targets_clearly_separate.rh_persistent_4of12: 4 consecutive stressed weeks inside a 12-week window
research_targets_clearly_separate.note: None of these replace the frozen PV target, which is untouched.

experiments.hypothesis: Sparse, concentrated positives explain most cross-seed instability.
experiments.result: 9/20 worlds have any test positive; median 0; 42 of 393 positives land in a test split

experiments.hypothesis: At observed counts, two equally good models differ by more than the M2C lift by chance.
experiments.result: PR-AUC sd/mean 2.3-4.3 at 3-8 positives; P(|delta|>0.0587)=1.7% per world

experiments.hypothesis: Attribution saturates; exposure is zero-inflated and heavy-tailed.
experiments.result: episode contribution median 0.999, 97% >=0.30; exposure 89.4% <1e-3, skew 4.8, kurt 34.3, group Gini 0.797

experiments.hypothesis: The relative-wealth multiplier is anti-predictive and cancels the source-stress signal.
experiments.result: peer stress AUC 0.7154 (18/20); multiplier AUC 0.0901 (0/20); product AUC 0.4482 (8/20)

experiments.hypothesis: H3-null: no corrected variant shows stable incremental value over B.
experiments.changed: feature variants and model class only
experiments.result: 2 of 10 tests passed the naive rule (logreg C2 p=0.0117, C3 p=0.0391); Model A also beat B, a sanity failure
experiments.falsified_prediction: P1 claimed monotone transforms are tree no-ops; within-week percentile rank is not monotone, so C2 != C (max diff 0.222)

experiments.hypothesis: The E3 wins are multiple-comparison false positives and will not replicate at higher power.
experiments.result: Bonferroni kills both (C2 p=0.094, C3 p=0.313); on rt_new_stress (375 positives, 20 worlds) every variant null and C2 reverses sign to -0.0182

experiments.hypothesis: Propagation may be predictive at another horizon, or only in some network structures.
experiments.changed: research horizon targets only; PV untouched
experiments.result: peer stress AUC rises with horizon 0.53->0.72; persistent stress inverse (0.13, 0/20); exposure below chance at every horizon
experiments.outcome: partial for horizon; structure claim retracted by E6

experiments.hypothesis: The E5 structure result is self-conditioning inflation.
experiments.result: self-conditioned AUC 0.8896 (20/20) vs independently conditioned 0.6035 (14/20), weaker than unconditioned 0.7154

verdict: No robust incremental predictive information from propagation-aware exposure. The frozen M2C conclusion is corroborated and mechanistically explained, not overturned.
must_not_claim: Model C is superior or any variant beat Model B
Repairing the multiplier would make propagation exposure valuable (C3 tested, null)
Propagation exposure contains no information in principle (only: none incremental to B on this population)
Propagation effects concentrate in particular network structures (circular, retracted)
Any causal relationship between peer stress and borrower stress
Any generalisation to real microfinance populations
